question.text: India's life expectancy at birth increased from 58 years in 1990 to approximately how many years by 2020, according to World Bank data cited in the NISM workbook?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XVII Retirement Adviser workbook (page 17), India's life expectancy at birth rose from 58 years in 1990 to 69.8 years in 2020, citing the World Bank as source. Page 18 connects this rising life expectancy to longevity risk. The Trap: Options C (72.3) and D (75.0) are plausible-sounding distractors that reflect projections from other sources; the workbook specifically cites 69.8 years. Note: Anchor longevity-risk discussions to the workbook's own 58 to 69.8 trend rather than to assumed planning ages not stated on pages 17-18.
